cases.question: How many errors?
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE severity='ERROR'

cases.question: Count by severity
cases.sql: SELECT severity, count(*) FROM logs GROUP BY severity

cases.question: Show warning logs
cases.sql: SELECT body FROM logs WHERE severity='WARNING'

cases.question: How many since 10 AM?
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 10:00:00'

cases.question: List severities, including repeated values
cases.sql: SELECT severity FROM logs ORDER BY timestamp

cases.question: Show billing log text
cases.sql: SELECT body FROM logs WHERE service_name='billing'
